acceptanceCriteria: CAL-V0-106 is inside ## Requirements and counted by OCM.
A check (or parser test) refuses requirement IDs defined outside the Requirements section, or the spec convention documents why it is allowed.
body: Codex review of V1-0979 found that requirements placed outside the `## Requirements` section of docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md are skipped by the OCM parser (internal/lrfrepo/ocm.go around line 555). V1-0979 moved its own CAL-V0-186; CAL-V0-106 (the V1-0854 amendment) has the same placement. Suspected: other specs may carry the same pattern. Found by the V1-0979 lane, 2026-10-07, base 0b5096ca. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks build 202.

title: agent-leases spec: CAL-V0-106 sits outside ## Requirements, so the OCM parser does not count it
